scope: Four-frame preprocessing only; direct internal calls with bounded synthetic uint16 planes. This does not establish authentic sensor metadata or full NEF-to-NEFX fidelity.

abi.argument: Pointer to a 64-byte descriptor: int32 width and height at offsets 0 and 4, four pointers to MSVC uint16 vector objects at offsets 8, 16, 24, 32, then 24 selector bytes at offset 40.
abi.vector: 24 bytes: begin, end, capacity pointers. The probe provides sufficient capacity and checks that the callee preserves all three pointers.

arithmetic.inputs: Four original planes A0..A3; mutable work planes initially copy all input samples.
definitions: Each frame uses two ordered selection stages; the second may overwrite the first. The complete executable branch equations are in repair_value().
arithmetic.precision: Input uint16-to-float conversion and two-sample means are exact over the tested 14-bit range. Decision ratios use float64. The estimate denominator rounds once to float32 before the outer float64 division.
arithmetic.zero_denominators: 0/0 is NaN; positive/0 is positive infinity. COMISD/JBE includes unordered comparisons. Preserve zero-weight terms because infinity*0 and NaN*0 remain NaN.
arithmetic.conversion: MINSD with 16383 as the first operand and candidate as the second retains candidate NaN; CVTTSD2SI converts NaN to INT_MIN, whose low 16 bits are zero. Finite positive candidates truncate after an upper cap at 16383. Positive infinity caps to 16383.
arithmetic.work_buffer_order: Decision statistics always read originals. Estimate neighborhoods read mutable work planes, so earlier selected rows can influence later estimates. Each coordinate processes frames 0,1,2,3.
arithmetic.asymmetry: The low-ratio intensity guard for frame 0 reads A3[y,x]; the other three frames read their own original current sample.

selection.reference: Selection.coordinates() and the independent C bounds check
selection.row_order: Row starts at first_row-trunc((reference_height-height)/2). Outer, middle, and inner increments are cumulative; nested iterations do not reset to an origin row.
selection.column_order: Half-grid index runs 1..width/2-2. Start a sample column at 1. Increment it by 2 only for accepted half-grid indices other than index 1. Filtering early half-grid indices therefore does not imply column=2*index-1.
selection.probe_bounds: The 16x12 probe rejects selected neighborhoods outside rows 2..9, columns 1..14 and rejects more than 1000 selector iterations. The vendor routine does not establish these safety checks.

verification.cases_description: 12 constant planes and 10000 fixed-seed cases: full 14-bit random values, boundary-value palettes, low-contrast values, and zero-heavy values. Twelve selector configurations include cumulative rows, repeated rows, first/last safe row, reference dimension changes, horizontal filtering, and no selections.
verification.coverage_limit: All 13 recorded write/keep action categories ran in every frame. These counters instrument the reference, not vendor machine-code edge coverage. Random and boundary-value fixtures do not prove all representable inputs.

threshold_neighborhoods.construction: Four frame orientations, fourteen controlled neighborhoods each, three neighboring integer settings per neighborhood. Exact rational construction ensures 14-bit integer fixture samples; the vendor and reference then perform the actual binary floating-point calculations.
threshold_neighborhoods.limit: The t=r+0.1 triplet keeps the same output in each orientation, so those four triplets verify values but do not distinguish branch direction. The upper clipping triplet exercises the cap path, not every possible representable cap crossing.

remaining: Exhaustive representable-value coverage is not established by these finite fixtures
